title: The 80,000 Pounds Talaat Harb Raised Only From Egyptians
conflicts: Founding date given variously as 8 March (private agreement), 13 April (decree) and 7 May 1920 (Harb's statement); the story uses each for what it was. The 126 original subscribers figure appears only in Daily News Egypt's anniversary history and is attributed; capital of 80,000 pounds agrees across sources. Harb's title: 1927 reports call him vice-chairman and managing director, Vitalis calls Yusuf Cattaoui the original vice-chairman; the story omits Harb's title. 1939: Enterprise & Society says the palace made support conditional on his resignation, Wikipedia says only that he was replaced; the story follows the journal.
notes: 1920 and 1926 growth figures rest on one contemporary French press report (1927), reproduced by entreprises-coloniales.fr. Vitalis's revisionist view (the nationalist image is sentimental; Harb kept ties with foreign capital) is respected by not calling the bank anti-imperialist. The quote is spoken by Tsze-hsia in Analects XIX.10; 58 words, under the limit.
